key: Take Ms. Craudburry's Pokémon?
en: Take Ms. Craudburry's Pokémon?
ja: クラウドバリーさんのポケモンを持っていきますか?

key: MAXWELL: No, quickly, \PN! Get it before they do!
en: MAXWELL: No, quickly, \PN! Get it before they do!
ja: マクスウェル: だめだ、急げ\PN! 奴らより先に手に入れろ!

key: ARCHER: \PN, what are you doing? Quickly, take it!
en: ARCHER: \PN, what are you doing? Quickly, take it!
ja: アーチャー: \PN、何をしている? 早く、持っていけ!

key: A note is scribbed on top of the book:
en: A note is scribbed on top of the book:
ja: 本の上に、何かメモが走り書きされている。

key: "85evs"
en: "85evs"
ja: 85evs

key: Halt, Aqua scum! My MANLINESS shall stop you!
en: Halt, Aqua scum! My MANLINESS shall stop you!
ja: 止まれ、アクアのクズどもめ! オレの男気が貴様らを止めてやる!

key: My manliness... was poorly man-aged...
en: My manliness... was poorly man-aged...
ja: オレの筋肉は……筋を通せてなかったか……

key: ...I've been dis-man-tled...
en: ...I've been dis-man-tled...
ja: ……オレは、バラされちまった……

key: ...Halt.
en: ...Halt.
ja: ……待て。
……ふん。

key: MAXWELL: \PN! Grab the Pokémon before Aqua does!
en: MAXWELL: \PN! Grab the Pokémon before Aqua does!
ja: マクスウェル: \PN! アクアより先にポケモンをつかめ!

key: ARCHER: Quickly, \PN! Seize the Pokémon before the Magmas do!
en: ARCHER: Quickly, \PN! Seize the Pokémon before the Magmas do!
ja: アーチャー: 急げ、\PN! マグマより先にポケモンを確保しろ!

key: MAXWELL: No! They got it... You guys... picked up a new member?
en: MAXWELL: No! They got it... You guys... picked up a new member?
ja: マクスウェル: くそっ! 取られた……お前ら……新入りを拾ったのか?

key: ARCHER: Indeed we did. Aqua Gang, our objective is complete. Let's retreat at once!
en: ARCHER: Indeed we did. Aqua Gang, our objective is complete. Let's retreat at once!
ja: アーチャー: いかにも。アクア団、目的は達成した。直ちに撤退するぞ!

key: DEFACTO: The city police force will most likely be arriving shortly. Let us evacuate swiftly.
en: DEFACTO: The city police force will most likely be arriving shortly. Let us evacuate swiftly.
ja: デファクト: 市警察がまもなく到着するだろう。速やかに退避しよう。

key: ARCHER: \PN, we'll meet you back at base. Excellent job.
en: ARCHER: \PN, we'll meet you back at base. Excellent job.
ja: アーチャー: \PN、拠点で落ち合おう。よくやった。

key: DEFACTO: Give it up, Magma! Just based on types alone, you're at an irreconcilable disadvantage!
en: DEFACTO: Give it up, Magma! Just based on types alone, you're at an irreconcilable disadvantage!
ja: デファクト: あきらめろ、マグマ! タイプ相性だけでも、お前たちには覆しようのない不利がある!

key: \PN! Quickly, get the loot!
en: \PN! Quickly, get the loot!
ja: \PN! 急げ、獲物を手に入れろ!

key: BREAK: It's lights out for you, Aqua! Metaphorical lights, OUT.
en: BREAK: It's lights out for you, Aqua! Metaphorical lights, OUT.
ja: ブレーク: 消灯の時間だぜ、アクア! 比喩的な意味でな、消えろ。

key: Oh, \PN! Mind stealing the Pokémon we came to get before they do? That could be useful. Maybe.
en: Oh, \PN! Mind stealing the Pokémon we came to get before they do? That could be useful. Maybe.
ja: おお、\PN! 奴らより先に、ここに来た目的のポケモンを盗んでくれるか? 役に立つかもな、多分。

key: Carvanha is focused on the battle!
en: Carvanha is focused on the battle!
ja: キバニアはバトルに集中している!

key: MAXWELL: We got it! Magma, disengage! There's no point to fighting here any longer!
en: MAXWELL: We got it! Magma, disengage! There's no point to fighting here any longer!
ja: マクスウェル: 手に入れたぞ! マグマ、離脱だ! もうここで戦う意味はねえ!

key: BREAK: We gotta bounce before the po-po come~
en: BREAK: We gotta bounce before the po-po come~
ja: ブレーク: サツが来る前に、とんずらしようぜ~

key: ARCHER: Ugh. You guys recruited a new member, huh? How lucky for you...
en: ARCHER: Ugh. You guys recruited a new member, huh? How lucky for you...
ja: アーチャー: くっ。新入りを迎え入れたのか。運がいいことだな……

key: Aqua Gang, retreat!
en: Aqua Gang, retreat!
ja: アクア団、撤退!

key: MAXWELL: Meet us back at base, \PN!
en: MAXWELL: Meet us back at base, \PN!
ja: マクスウェル: 拠点で落ち合おうぜ、\PN!

key: Houndour is focused on the battle!
en: Houndour is focused on the battle!
ja: デルビルはバトルに集中している!

key: Don't move a muscle! Don't move any of your muscles!
en: Don't move a muscle! Don't move any of your muscles!
ja: 一筋も動くな! 筋肉一本たりとも動かすんじゃねえ!

key: Making your Pokémon move muscles for you, verrrry clever.
en: Making your Pokémon move muscles for you, verrrry clever.
ja: 自分の代わりにポケモンに筋肉を動かさせるとはな。うーん賢いぜ

key: ...I'm onto your tricks.
en: ...I'm onto your tricks.
ja: ……お前の手の内は、もうお見通しだぜ。

key: Hey, you new to this scene? Some advice: your choicest maneuver is to throw up the white flag!
en: Hey, you new to this scene? Some advice: your choicest maneuver is to throw up the white flag!
ja: よお、このあたりじゃ新顔か? 忠告してやるが、お前の最善手は白旗を揚げることだぜ!

key: ...Well played.
en: ...Well played.
ja: ……見事だったぜ

key: That's a very strange phraseology, actually... Choicest? While it is technically correct, I do believe modern dialect has surpassed it...
en: That's a very strange phraseology, actually... Choicest? While it is technically correct, I do believe modern dialect has surpassed it...
ja: 実に奇妙な言い回しだな……「最善手」? 厳密には正しいが、現代の言葉遣いはそれをとうに超えていると思うが……

en: Yes
ja: はい
